narr: Flooding occurred in portions of Montgomery and Austin Counties as storms moved through the area during the night of April 6 and morning of April 7.
ev: High water was reported in the Dobbin area due to heavy rain around the intersection of Dobbin Rd and FM1486.
lsr: HIGH WATER ON ROADS IN THE DOBBIN AREA, INCLUDING THE INTERSECTION OF DOBBIN ROAD AND COUNTRY ROAD, AND THE INTERSECTION OF MOUNT MARIAH ROAD AND FM 1486.
